findings.quote: Do not infer, estimate, convert between conditions, or calculate any number that a sheet does not state.
findings.source: Do not browse or infer missing numbers.
findings.reason: The original prohibits inferring missing source values. The output additionally prohibits all calculated numbers absent verbatim from a sheet, including an exact comparison difference or a unit conversion derived entirely from stated values. This closes a permitted comparison method beyond the original missing-value restriction. The outside-block description of the additions as small clarifications does not narrow the blanket rule.

limitations: This is same-operator model review, not independent human evidence or execution verification. No superiority or expected-count assumption was used.
All 14 supplied originals and submissions in this frozen snapshot were reviewed. No mappings or other project results were inspected for this audit, and prior audit reports were not modified.
Findings concern the actual copyable handoff text. Outside-block explanations and self-declared success do not cure contradictions, additions, or weakened invariants in that text.

The same materiality threshold was retained: harmless formatting, faithful decomposition, ordinary requested-outcome evidence, and visibly optional suggestions were not counted as drift. Legitimate missing-input templates and blocked handoffs were accepted.

For item-02, reporting stated conditions, multiple source figures, and source locations was treated as faithful comparison decomposition; the explicit global calculation prohibition is the material restriction. General preparation language in item-10 was read within its explicit owner authority list, as in the preceding review.
Readiness describes usability and input or authority holds. It does not prove successful code execution, testing, CI, merge, or deployment.
